name: Dreads
overview: Scripture teaches that believers are called to reject fear and dread because the Lord is present with them as a mighty and powerful God. Rather than being afraid, God’s people are encouraged to be strong and courageous, trusting that He will never fail or forsake them. When fear arises, the proper response is to place confidence in God’s protection and steadfastness, fixing the heart on Him rather than on troubling news or circumstances.
